scope: skills/ working contour: 32 skill folders (bmad-*/bmod-* + hub bmad) with SKILL.md, references/, assets/, scripts/ and module bmod.toml. tools/, docs-site/, docs/, .github/, CHANGELOG.md, action.yml and repository metadata are deliberately OUT of the vendored contour.
scopeNote: The BMAD method is a tightly cross-linked skill tree (32 skills + Python/uv helper scripts under skill scripts/, run via `uv run <script>`). Splitting into per-skill cards breaks the method, so the whole tree is vendored as one bundle asset. The Python/uv runtime that BMad scripts rely on is NOT vendored here; it is declared as a compatibility note on install (device must provide uv, or install it).
